topic: Paths that contain another job's root are refused
detail: Per RC-36 (1), block-other-jobs refuses a path, cd destination, git dir or glob prefix that contains another isolated space's root (grep -r ~/code, cd ~/code && rg x, find / ..., ls ~/code), because Targets cannot tell a recursive reader from a listing. This adds friction for sessions under a public root (cd ~/code before a git clone, ls ~/code). Confirm, or decide to allow a listing-only set of commands (ls, cd alone) once Targets can report it.
